mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.email, u.password_hash AS passwordHash, u.nickname, u.avatar_object_key AS avatarObjectKey, r.code AS role, u.status, u.onboarding_completed AS onboardingCompleted, u.must_change_password AS mustChangePassword, u.auth_version AS authVersion FROM users u JOIN roles r ON r.id = u.role_id AND r.is_active = 1 WHERE u.email = #{email} FOR UPDATE

SELECT u.id, u.email, u.password_hash AS passwordHash, u.nickname, u.avatar_object_key AS avatarObjectKey, r.code AS role, u.status, u.onboarding_completed AS onboardingCompleted, u.must_change_password AS mustChangePassword, u.auth_version AS authVersion FROM users u JOIN roles r ON r.id = u.role_id AND r.is_active = 1 WHERE u.admin_login_name = #{adminLoginName} AND r.code = 'ADMIN' FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.id, r.user_id AS userId, r.expires_at AS expiresAt, r.revoked_at AS revokedAt, role.code AS role, u.status, u.auth_version AS authVersion FROM refresh_tokens r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id JOIN roles role ON role.id = u.role_id AND role.is_active = 1 WHERE r.token_hash = #{tokenHash} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_tokens (id, user_id, token_hash, parent_token_id, expires_at) VALUES (#{token.id}, #{token.userId}, #{token.tokenHash}, #{token.parentTokenId}, #{token.expiresAt})
